identity_and_theme.name: Eco-Precision Enterprise
identity_and_theme.design_vibe: Industrial yet pristine visual language tailored for circular manufacturing, resource tracking, and high-precision ERP/MES operations. Fuses Scandinavian cleanroom clarity with maritime technical telemetry, deep breathing room, ultra-fine dividers, and subtle cyan-tinted atmospheric light.
identity_and_theme.use_case: Full lifecycle recycled-plastic production, MES, traceability, and inventory ERP (Granules → Extrusion/Lumber/Sheets → Finished Products → Public Deployments) for floor operators, managers, partners, and boardroom executives.

universal_guidelines: Follow the Eco-Precision Enterprise clean modern aesthetic: dual-surface white on mist, oceanic glassmorphism, bright pure white cards.
Use Plus Jakarta Sans for titles/headers, Inter for body/forms, and JetBrains Mono for SKUs, batch IDs, metrics, and ledger hashes.
Ensure cards use rounded-2xl with subtle cyan ambient shadows and 1px #E2E8F0 borders.
Primary CTAs use the linear gradient from #3195C9 to #0091FF.
Badges and status chips must use rounded-full pills.
Maintain high visual contrast between text (#010B1C / #334155) and card backgrounds (#FFFFFF).
Use Sonner for toast notifications and ensure all interactive elements retain data-testid attributes.
